nom: Garnier SkinActive Micellar Cleansing Water with Rose Water

avis.titre: It's OK, but the original is better
avis.texte: I am in love with the original (blue formula) from Garnier, but I thought I would give this one a try. I wish I hadn't! It removes most of my makeup but does a pretty bad job with mascara (I mostly use tubing mascaras). This one would be a good option if you want to change your makeup but not your lashes.

avis.titre: Gentle, Glowy, and My Skin Loves It!
avis.texte: Perfect for my morning and evening routine and it's become a staple in my skincare ritual. Highly recommend for anyone with sensitive or mature skin who wants something effective and nourishing!

I have used this product basically since it came out. I find that other Micellar waters either smell bad, are drying, or leave residue. I like this one because my face always feels refreshed, not irritated, and no noticeable residue. I think the packaging is cute and effective at dispensing in the smaller size bottle. I have emptied more bottles of this than I can count and I will continue to buy! The only con is that it does not cut through heavier makeup very well for me, which is fine because I tend to use it as a light cleanser anyways.

avis.titre: I continue to buy this product over and over!
avis.texte: I love the Garnier SkinActive Micellar Cleansing Water as it removes my makeup and doesn't dry out my skin. A friend of mine actually turned it on to me and I have not stopped using it since! No hard chemicals either! Its the best!
It removes my makeup well but it burns my eyessss and I've tried 3 different versions 😭 helppp why do they all burn so bad

avis.titre: How does this have so many good reviews?
avis.texte: I used to use Garnier Micellar water loyally a few years ago, but did cleansing balm for a little bit. I decided to come back to what i thought was my tried and true and HOLY MOLY this is the worst makeup remover I have EVER used. Does NOT remove mascara at all, and it stings when I use it. I've used it 4 times now and have wasted 1/4 of the bottle with the amount I have had to use.

I never wanted to wear mascara because it was such a pain to take off. Well, now I wear it daily because it is so easy to take it off with this water. I love how easy it is to use and the bottle lasts a very long time. I would recommend this to others to use for a clean face.
I have dry skin & this cleanser leaves my face clean & hydrated.

I thought I would try this as I love the other micellar waters, but turns out it made my sensitive skin irritated. My eyes would be burning after using it and my face would break out into a rash. Returned less than a week.
i love most of the micellar waters from this brand. i like rosewater and this does feel very refreshing. im not sure if its very hydrating though, maybe just compared to the other ones.
i bought this cleanser bc i was in a rush and omg it's so refreshing to put on ur face, smells great, and removes makeup easily! i will def be repurchasing.

It works just like the other ones. Removes all my makeup and it doesn't feel damaging on my skin. The only downside is it smells very strong of rose water. I was expecting a light scent but it lowkey smells like perfume
I received a free maybelline mascara with it and this just makes my skin glowy, cleanses and of course removes makeup!

avis.titre: I am an MUA and this is a NO
avis.texte: I have used micellar waters for years on myself and other people as a make-up artist. In my opinion and personal experience (which I will focus on here) this product is not appropriate for very sensitive skin. Also, micellar waters should (in a perfect world) be rinsed off the face. However, everyone has a lazy day (or night) sometimes. This product burned my skin and left my eyes itchy, red, burning and raw with what felt like chemical burns. I admit that I have sensitive skin in general but my skin can tolerate some retinoids so I was shocked when this product was so volatile for me. Some people may be sensitive to rose but I honestly don't know what ingredient might be the culprit. I have used Bioderma and have never had this problem but it costs more. If you have any sensitivities with your skin use caution.

This dried out my skin on my face so badly it was inflamed and red. I've been trying to restore it for over a week and it's been a painful process. I used the other micellar cleanser without issue. Be careful using this one.

Garnier Skin Active Micellar Water with Rose Water is a gentle makeup remover with a nice rose scent. Effectively removes mascara and foundation without scrubbing or pulling your skin. I highly recommend this Micellar water as it is a generous size.

avis.titre: I would by this product again
avis.texte: My sister in law showed this to me and I used it and absolutely love it takes the make up right off making my face feel fresh and clean!
Favorite makeup cleanser ! Only one I use and it's great on my skin.

POV: dry skin, 18 years old Rating: 4 out of 10 I have tried to give this product a chance, but I can't. It dries my skin out, my under eyes when I try to get mascara off, my face, and my neck. I have tried the Garnier micellar cleansing water with vitamin C, and it works incredibly, but this product dries my skin out.
After a couple of days of use, my eyelids were swollen almost shut and skin is red and burns all over face!

I love Garnier's Micellar water, but this one is disappointing. I have dry skin. It removed my makeup easily like it normally does. It didn't burn me like it seems to have done so to others. I don't have sensitive skin. I've always washed my face with my favorite cleanser after makeup removal. Even after washing my face, this product left my skin feeling very oily and tacky. I woke up the next morning with breakouts. It just feels like theirs a layer of grossness over my face, like it feels dirty. I won't be using it again.

avis.titre: Please avoid this product if you have sensitive skin!
avis.texte: This product has caused my skin so many irritation problems. My under-eye area stings so much after using this product. It still stings! It also caused me to breakout. It also does not remove makeup efficiently either. This product is not suitable for sensitive skin! Use the blue original one instead. Avoid this product please!

I've been using this product for years and it's still just as amazing as the first time I tried it! I keep a travel size bottle with me for easy clean up and up keep. Works best with coconut oil when removing makeup. Love love love this product and it's consistency.
Just use a cotton ball to swipe the micellar cleansing product all over my face & neck. Very invigorating & my follow up routine with DRMTLGY products go on so smooth & silky ❤️❤️❤️
I use this product on my face before washing. It has been really helping with getting moisture into my skin.

For those wondering why it burns, the new bottles contain salicylic acid! My daughter wondered why for months her eyes and skin was peeling and burned and that explains it. Took several weeks for her skin to heal. Be careful, especially around your eyes and if you use retinols/retinoids.

avis.titre: This is the best of the best!
avis.texte: Out of all the micellar waters this is clearly the best. Takes off all the makeup has some rose water and smells delightful.
Used this for several years and it's my favorite. On sale so I got the large size.

I use this product mainly on my eye makeup because sometimes washing it alone doesn't take the mascara off. This product is great with taking my mascara, eyeliner and eyeshadow off. I absolutely love it. I think the first day I used it I used too much because it made my face feel sticky and it felt like my skin couldn't breathe, so I had to wash my face. But mainly use on my eye makeup.

Great affordable Micellar water! I use this specific one to cleanup under my eyes after doing my eye makeup. It cleans up the eyeshadow fallout without leaving an oily/greasy residue. It makes my skin feel clean and it smells good.
I love, love, love this stuff! No harsh rubbing to remove makeup & doesn't leave my skin oily.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Does take off my makeup after a long day but I have to keep using the product to remove everything and then it leaves my face dry

I have used this particular product for over a year and I love it in all seasons. I love everything rose and this being micellar water only makes it better. I don't wear a great deal of daily makeup- shape tape under eyes and around nose, Benefit highlighter on cheeks, MAC eyeliner, and clean mascara. This is all I use to clean my face. It doesn't always get the eye makeup off my eyes but gets most but the rest of my face is always clean. I can see it on the pad and know it is working. I do apply lotion afterwards since I'm now almost 41 and gravity requires it but this water keeps my skin clean, toned and refreshed. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: It's a good makeup remover an leaves my face feeling clean
avis.texte: I use it every nite to remove any make up or oil from my face

I don't wear full face makeup only eye makeup and this product helps remove my eye makeup but the best thing about it is that I've been cleaning my face with it day and night and have watched my skin clear up since day 1. Wearing masks at work it's great to remove all the build up from the day!

avis.titre: This is a surfactant, i.e. a soap-so rinse!
avis.texte: Chemist, but not a cosmetic one specifically. This is essentially a soap, that's why it's leaving some of you with sticky feeling skin. This is good stuff in my opinion, I mostly use it to clean my brushes and other makeup tools. Just Please rinse and you'll prob love this inexpensive gem, Big Bang for your buck if you use a lot like I do.
the pink cap is way better. i feel like this takes a lot to remove my eye makeup and i've noticed it hasn't been helping with my dry patches either. not horrible but wouldn't buy it again

I love this makeup remover I've had wipes as my makeup remover and when I turned to this cleanser it made my face feel fresh and the makeup was removed so easily I didn't have to rub to get anything off the first try! Love it!
Very good works great for my skin. Definitely buy this product. The brand is one of the best.
Um they didn't even cut the top of the bottle to open it… they literally left all the plastic molded together and there is no way to get the whole cap off
works great and is nice and gentle. definitely give this a try if you're curious. oh and it lasts forever! you definitely get your money's worth.

avis.titre: Prefer the OG pink cap version
avis.texte: I sent my boyfriend to buy the OG version and he came back with this. I decided to use it anyway and immediately regretted it. It doesn't take off makeup as well as the original, especially mascara. It kinda burns my skin and eyes. I've been using it for weeks and it hasn't broken me out at least, but I wish my boyfriend had kept the receipt so I could exchange it lol
Waste of money. Smeared eye makeup ball over my face. Have used Garnier micellar water for several years. Stay away from the rose water. Wasted my $$$.

Oh, I love this product! I have hypothyroidism and have had dry patches on my face which wearing a mask has not helped. After only a few times using this, they are pretty much gone. Thank you for making this rose water version for extra moisture.
Smells good, but terrible at removing makeup. You're better off just using soap.

This is so good! I've been trying to clear my acne for a while, and after just a few days, my skin felt so much smoother with this. I used a Cerave benzoyl peroxide and other cleansers before, but this one removed all my pimples/acne!
works great and is super cheap! it's gentle and can take off all my black eye makeup and heavy makeup looks!
I am in love with all their Micellar waters! Takes off my makeup well and doesn't leave my skin burning

If I could give this zero stars I would. If you want to wake up to chemical burns on your eye lids and red bumpy rash all over the rest of your face then this product is for you. Will never buy any skin care from Garnier again.

I use this product before bedtime to whisk away the day. It feels so cooling on my face and I can see by the used cotton pad that it's working. Since the pandemic, I haven't worn any foundation but I do moisturize every day. I have used a few of Garnier's cleansing waters and I like this one the best - maybe it's the rosewater.
I always use this to clean my eyelash extensions! Love love love.

I used this a few times & now it has started to BURN when I take my eye makeup off. I'm avoiding wearing eye makeup because of this! It's so hard to find a product that doesn't burn! Will never buy again!
Removes my make up very well, except madcara, I need to use an oil first. I feels very good and light and I use it as a toner in the morning.
I like this a lot. It's great on my sensitive skin. Other products have burned my eyes & feels rough, but this is very nice & gentle. A little thick feeling, but it works great.
I usually put it on a cotton pad and just use it in my face for a quick cleanse and it works amazing

avis.titre: TERRIBLE! GAVE ME A CHEMICAL BURN AND MY EYES HURT!
avis.texte: I bought this new product, the rose one. All of a sudden I wake up in the middle of the night and see my eye just watering and BURNING!! My eye had a chem reaction and it was SOOOO RED! Terrible idk what to say, I used their products before and NOTHING LIKE THIS HAPPENED AT ALL! Btw I am not allergic not is my skin sensitive.
i wanted to like this but i found that it stung my eyes :/ i like the original formula better.
I use it every morning and every night, gentle on my sensitive skin

Let me start off by saying that I do NOT have sensitive skin.... I was really excited about this as I love rose water but this burned my skin SO badly... as I said before, I don't have sensitive skin and nothing has ever really bothered me...until I tried this. So disappointed

I'm so glad I found this micellar water! I wear light makeup (eyebrow pencil, mascara, lipstick/gloss, occasional blush) and this is all I need to remove it everyday. It works great and doesn't harm my skin. I don't plan on using anything anytime soon!!

I've tried every micellar out there, including others within Garnier, this is the only one I can use on my reactive skin. All others either have alcohol, a scent, or hexylene glycol, which all agitate my skin. This one does not, and takes my makeup off perfectly. I always wash after using, to make sure all residue is removed. Never had issues. Will repurchase for sure.
I use this product to wipe off my makeup before cleansing my face and it works perfectly
I can't believe I was using makeup wipes for so long before using this. My skin feels so much cleaner.
I use this to take off makeup sometimes before my regular cleanser.

avis.titre: Where has this been my whole life???
avis.texte: Love this! Sooo easy to use. It gently, quickly & conveniently removes ALL makeup completely with just a few swipes & NO harsh rubbing. It's great for heavy makeup or just a sweaty face after a workout & everything in between. It doesn't dry out your skin. There's no irritation, although I do not have sensitive skin. It's the end all, be all product that I wish I had starting at age 13! Highly recommend for any and all!

This is my GO TO makeup remover. It removes everything! My skin is very sensitive and most makeup removers irritate it but not this one! This remover leave my skin feeling refreshed after I use it and doesn't leave a sticky residue.
It removed all my make up and even lash glue with a cotton swab.

I love this product. I use it after I've already washed my face to get any of the yucky stuff my cleanser may have missed. I use very little on a cotton ball and swipe. It pulls all the remaining gunk off my skin leaving it hydrated and not dry and burning (I'm sensitive) I've been experiencing "mask face acne" so this in rotation with witch hazel has helped incredibly. I noticed right away it has a similar feel to the Aveda hydrating lotion I used to use! Although both have different purposes, I like this one better because it cleanses as well! Love the rose water and will continue to buy.

Guys, all the complaints about how it "leaves your skin feeling sticky, oily, itchy, etc....". Common sense tells you to wash it OFF when you're done. This is just a STEP in the nightly cleansing ritual. It's makeup removal, that's all. I don't think it's good or the least bit healthy to just leave it on your face and say you're done cleansing. I can't imagine putting my serums or moisturizer on over it, and thinking I'm done. It's got to leave tiny bits of smeared makeup on your skin. Eww. It's a step, not the end-al be-all of face cleaning. Wash your face afterwards! The problems will stop immediately if you do!

avis.titre: I got burned from this product!!!
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin which became irritated when using makeup wipes so I thought this would be a nice alternative, especially since it says for sensitive skin on the bottle. I bought this in store and went to use it that night. Not only did I break out into red blotches from an allergic reaction, I also got a chemical burn where I took off the makeup under my eyes. So buy at your own risk but I'm never buying this product again.

avis.titre: Good for sensitive skin, has some cons though.
avis.texte: So overall, I LOVED this product! It didn't irritate my super sensitive skin and took off makeup easily. The reason I only gave it 4 stars is it was like oddly soap like. For example when I put it on a cotton round it almost like bubbled up in a way. I wasn't expecting that since it wasn't described as a soapy product. Besides that, I would def try this.
I like to use this to remove makeup. Sometimes I will use after being outside gardening just to freshen up.

Although it does get your makeup off really good, it leaves my skin feeling sticky. I have oily skin and this product isn't the best for my skin. I prefer the original one because it doesn't irritate or anything and helps take my makeup off perfectly.
This product is not for me. It leaves a weird sticky film on my face that I am not a fan of. It's not unusable, I will be finishing it since I bought it. But definitely not repurchasing.
it's an okay micellar water, but I've tried better at a similar price point. didnt like how my face felt after using, left it tacky and not in a good way. will finish the bottle, but not repurchase

avis.titre: No. I would not buy this product again. I returned it.
avis.texte: I didn't like the way my skin felt after this product dried, so as I said I rinsed it off.

I love this! It's gentle and doesn't irritate my acne-prone skin like the makeup wipes I used before. After I use it my face feels fresh and hydrated, not dry and tight. I like the scent, it's rosy and not too strong. I also like that this formula is free of bad ingredients and is vegan. I like all of Garnier's micellar waters, but this one is my new favorite.

avis.titre: I will def buy from now on
avis.texte: I got the Tarte micellar water in my BoxyCharm and I liked it but I like that you can squirt the garnier onto the pad instead of pumping it males it more sanitary
It's funny that I put a review and you guys deleted it. I would never buy this product.

avis.titre: Non-irritating, but maybe a little too gentle
avis.texte: I have normal skin, but it's also very sensitive. This product is smooth and doesn't need to be shaken up. I mainly like to use micellar water for my eye makeup and this product doesn't cause any eye irritation for me, but it doesn't exactly break down all of my makeup. I will either need to leave the cotton round over my eye for a few extra moments or I'll need wipe my eye a few extra times just to get everything or most of my makeup off.

avis.titre: Wonderful product- Cap needs some work
avis.texte: The product is great. Removes makeup like a charm. But I have a huge issue with the cap. It doesn't unscrew/pop off to saturate a cotton ball. You must squirt it out and it gets everywhere! It drips out in a sloppy way and I waste more than use it. Please, update the cap performance.
It gets slightly foamy/soapy when I use it on my skin. It also makes my skin feel a little dry. I would stick to the original micellar water. I'm disappointed, I really wanted to like this product :(

I always have a micellar water on deck to remove mascara. I'm not blown away by the results, but this one is consistent with other ones I have used. I do like the light rose scent for this product. I haven't noticed the drying that others have noted, but I don't really use the product for my full face- just around the brows and eyes.

Switching from the blue cap to this was a huge downgrade.. I only bought it because it was supposed to be hydrating and for sensitive skin. Well the packaging lied.. It's not hydrating and this burns and irritates my skin around my eyes when I remove my eye makeup and I'm not even rubbing that hard, I try to be very gentle while removing makeup or when I'm applying creams under my eyes. Id stick with the blue cap if you're thinking about buying this one.

I originally bought this product in an attempt to up my skin care game in my thirties and translation to cleaner ingredients in my skin care product. I love micellar water as it is so easy on my skin and doesn't strip my skin. The fact that this has a gentle rose scent is a HUGE plus. I love this product!

I always wear waterproof makeup and every makeup remover I've tried still makes me scrub a ton and really hard. This is extremely gentle on my skin, feels good, and easily gets all of my make up off in a few gentle strokes. Definitely a go to from now on!
use the original one but decided to give this a whirl. So far so good. I only use it in the morning so far, and I dont wash it off like I do the original version . Love it!

avis.titre: Barely works. Leaves egg yoke-ey foamy substance. Ew.
avis.texte: I tried to love this but I just couldn't. It feels like you're rubbing watered down egg yolk on your face, and then it leaves this weird white, foamy, gel-like substance on your skin and it feels literally so bad. It doesn't even dry and I have to wipe it off. No matter whether I wipe it off or not, it leaves my skin is so sticky. The thing is, the normal one with the pink or blue cap is lovely, so I don't understand how they are so different. The cons in this product outweigh the pros, so just get the normal one.

My 12 year old kept using my expensive miracle water so I bought this for her to use. I tried it to see what I thought. It works really well to clean and remove makeup, but it doesn't have the extra anti-aging that mine has and I could tell. This didn't irritate my skin either or make it feel "sticky" which sometimes happens with some products. I'd recommend for teens and 20's.
removes all my makeup with ease, i don't have to scrub my face to get it off! it also smells very nice and feels refreshing on your skin.

Zero stars.I was so excited when I seen garnier came out with a different micellar water and its hydrating with rosewater ?? yes ! ... but NO. I've used this multiple times and my face cheeks specifically dry up so bad .. I wanted to narrow down what the heck was doing that to my face so of course I go through the NEW products I've used because my face has never done this.. so I paid close attention when I used this and right away my skin felt so dehydrated! very weird !

This micellar water is great for removing makeup. Although I've never tried taking off a full face of makeup with it, it does wonders removing natural makeup. It also smells sooo good. It does leave your face feeling a little sticky after use, but this was the first micellar water I've used so I don't know if that's a norm.

I've been using the blue cap for a while and I'm really happy with it but decided to give this one a try because I love rose water and I HATED it. Leaves my skin feeling dry and it's foamy? I have to wipe the foam off with a clean pad but it's not enough, I still feel like I need to wash my face after using it.

This product works very well even when i have put lots of makeup on, it is very easy and does not require harsh rubbing like neutrogena makeup wipes. This product also has no fragrance which is very important for nice skin.

Had really high hopes for this I love anything with rose in it, however this did not smell anything like rose. You really got to take a big sniff to smell any amount of rose in this water, so save your money just buy the regular micellar water that does the same job, if you're buying this for rosewater you're wasting money
I seriously love this stuff!!! It's the perfect cleanser and it makes my face feel so clean. Ever since I've been using this my skin has been clear and no breakouts! A great every day product.
It must be the glycerin in this, but when using this one compared to their normal micellar water, it leaves an oily finish on my skin.

All the good reviews made me want to try it out and I absolutely love it. It does a great job of removing my make up and leaving face feeling great afterwards. I will definitely continue to buy and use this.

avis.titre: I would buy again. It picks up any dirt off your face.
avis.texte: It is really good for sensitive skin. It's very hydrating. I am most definitely purchasing this again.

I don't have to keep rewiping my face to get all of the makeup off, one good pass over the area & when I wash my face I still have a white washcloth. Stay away from your waterlines with this product. It left mine stinging & irritated.
I really love this, i use it before my cleanser! it really breaks up my eye makeup well.
this smells so good and leaves face clean after cleaning your face! feels good after a long day of make up!

I don't have sensitive skin, I don't have dry skin, I don't even have oily skin or acne. I have no idea what happened, but this dried my skin out to the point where I had to buy an expensive moisturizer for my eyelids because they were peeling. I had dry spots on my face from using this, but kept giving it the benefit of the doubt until I saw my eyes.
